name: band lying hip internal rotation
description: A prone, band-resisted hip internal rotation. With one knee bent, rotate the lower leg outward while keeping the thigh stable.
instructions: Lie face down with one knee bent to about 90 degrees and a light band attached to that ankle from the side.
Keep your pelvis and bent thigh on the floor.
Rotate the lower leg outward against the band, so the movement comes from the hip rather than the knee.
Pause briefly, return slowly, then repeat on the other side.
